action.objective: Commit dxe5, resolving the central tension and opening the d3 queen toward f1/b1 with a sound exact score at depth 3.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 4 (cutoff depth 2) had dxe5 on top at -180; full single-candidate verification reached depth 3 with an exact -191, PV dxe5 Nxe5 Qf1, no forced mate and no tactical refutation, and it is the only commit_ready move. The score is slightly behind quieter rook moves' depth-2 scores, but those are shallower/bounded and depth-mixed scores are not comparable. Nxe5 is answered by the queen dropping to f1 with the bishop already on a3, so Black's central knight is loose.
